shortDescription: Run the VSX operation by its name and parameters.

options.name: add_member_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to add a VSX Cluster member.

options.name: auto_publish_session
options.description: Publish the current session if changes have been performed after task completes.

options.name: downgrade_params
options.description:
Parameters for the operation to downgrade a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a lower version.
In case the current version is already the target version, or is lower than the target version, no change is done.

options.name: operation
options.description:
The name of the operation to run. Each operation has its specific parameters.
The available operations are,
  • upgrade - Upgrades the VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a higher version
  • downgrade - Downgrades the VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a lower version
  • add-member - Adds a new VSX Cluster member object
  • remove-member - Removes a VSX Cluster member object
  • reconf-gw - Reconfigures a VSX Gateway after a clean ins

options.name: reconf_gw_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to reconfigure a VSX Gateway after a clean install.

options.name: reconf_member_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to reconfigure a VSX Cluster member after a clean install.

options.name: remove_member_params
options.description: Parameters for the operation to remove a VSX Cluster member object.

options.name: upgrade_params
options.description:
Parameters for the operation to upgrade a VSX Gateway or VSX Cluster object to a higher version.
In case the current version is already the target version, or is higher than the target version, no change is done.

options.name: version
options.description: Version of checkpoint. If not given one, the latest version taken.

options.name: wait_for_task
options.description: Wait for the task to end. Such as publish task.

options.name: wait_for_task_timeout
options.description: How many minutes to wait until throwing a timeout error.
